Which do you like better the XBO controller thumb sticks or PS4's? I think I'd rather just use KB+M for shooters and the 360 controller for everything else.

Personally I like the concave tops to the XBO controller and I like having the left joystick higher up on the controller. I feel like this gives me a better grip with the left joystick higher up, but gives me more precision with the right joystick being lower on the controller. Even though we hold a controller with both hands, it makes sense to put more of your leverage on the left joystick since that's normally not as critical to fine movement like the right joystick, being the camera control for most games.

That said, I do appreciate the playstation controller layout and don't have any real criticisms of it either. Just two different approaches to joystick layout.

The trackpad I had a huge problem with at first in FPS games; I couldn't get that headshot-precision that's required in these games with the trackpad.

The gyroscopic controls are how you play FPS games on this, and it's not yet a default setting. Pressing in on the touchpad allows for precise aiming, as you move the controller around; it's awkward at first, and aiming this way will take a a week or two of practice to git gud with, but I managed to clear beginner-level Killing Floor solo on my first playthrough with it active as a sharpshooter; an added side-effect is that moving your arms around like that to aim actually makes the game feel exciting and somehow more interactive. I can see this method of aiming being a vast improvement to control-stick aiming with practice, but I don't recommend this to anyone whom does not want to have to learn new muscle memory.
